author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Thick curled bean-shaped body with two antennae at the head and short legs along the outer curve all swept back toward the tail, as in the reference; the current drawing had a pinched, lumpy outline with legs sticking out at random angles, and read as a knot or a splat.
omissions: Legs are kept only on the outer curve (5 legs); the reference's two legs by the tail are dropped to keep them clear of the curl.
